subject: Re: Redwood pricing & procurement path — hosted vs dedicated vs private
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood pricing & procurement path — hosted vs dedicated vs private

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side so procurement/legal have what they need:

Summary from call:
- Use case: external-facing consumer personalization for payments risk scoring (high token volume, PII concerns).
- Preferred infra: low-latency production; exploring Dedicated for throughput but evaluating Hosted for initial rollout.

Procurement questions we need to confirm:
1) Paper process: Do you require a vendor form + SOC2 and W9 prior to PO issuance?
2) Payment method: Will the initial order be placed via PO (preferred for enterprise procurement) or card?
3) Marketplace: Is purchasing through AWS Marketplace or another cloud marketplace preferable/required for your finance team?
4) Billing cadence: monthly invoice vs quarterly?

Pricing/packaging options (attached):
- Hosted (on-demand / card or invoice): fastest onboarding, no commit, pay-as-you-go.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): 6/12/24-month commits with significant unit-cost reduction; invoiced via PO for committed contracts.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): enterprise licensing + support; typically multi-quarter procurement and legal review.

Attachments: Pricing_Tiers_v3.xlsx (pricing by commit level), Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW template).

Recommended next steps:
- Confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and whether marketplace is required.
- If PO + committed Dedicated is preferred, we can provide a one-page commercial summary and an initial 12-month quote for approval.
- Schedule a short call with procurement/legal this week to review vendor paperwork.

Can you confirm the above and share any vendor form or procurement contact?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Pricing_Tiers_v3.xlsx] [Attachment: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@finservco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finservco.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & procurement path — hosted vs dedicated vs private

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement/legal side:
- We do require a completed vendor form + SOC 2 report and W9 before issuing a PO. Can you provide SOC2 + the contact who handles tax/W9?
- Payment method: our standard for new vendors is PO. Card is only used for POCs <$5k.
- Marketplace: we prefer purchasing through AWS Marketplace when possible (simplifies procurement), but it's not a hard requirement if your team can accept PO invoicing.
- Billing cadence: our finance team prefers monthly invoices tied to a PO for committed contracts.

On packaging: we are leaning toward a committed Dedicated deployment for production (12-month term) but would like to pilot on Hosted to validate performance. If you can provide a committed Dedicated quote (12 months) and a short commercial summary that calls out PO billing and monthly invoice cadence, that would help speed approvals.

I attached our vendor questionnaire for redwood to fill out — this needs to go to security for review.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager, FinServCo
[Attachment: FinServ_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & procurement path — hosted vs dedicated vs private

Thanks Lena — very helpful. Quick answers and proposed path: 

1) Vendor paperwork & SOC2: attaching our SOC 2 Type II and W9. Point of contact for vendor tax is finance@redwood.com (cc'ing Aditya).

2) PO vs Card: we support both. For POC < $5k we recommend card/credit for speed. For committed Dedicated (12m) we will issue standard PO+MSA. We can produce a one-page commercial summary that explicitly notes PO billing and monthly invoicing.

3) Marketplace: we are listed on AWS Marketplace for metered/hosted purchases; Dedicated purchases are typically direct and invoiced, but we can explore marketplace private offers if your team prefers consolidated procurement through AWS. That adds some lead time but is possible.

4) Pilot -> Production path: start Hosted (on-demand) for a 2–4 week performance validation, then convert to Dedicated 12m commit for production. We can include commit credits for onboarding.

See attached updated Pricing_Tiers_v3.xlsx with a 12-month Dedicated price column and a short commercial summary (link below). I'll get legal/commercial to prepare an MSA/MU and a short quote for the PO.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync this Thursday 10/4 to run through the vendor questionnaire, confirm billing cadence and finalize the 12-month quote. Are you available?

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Pricing_Tiers_v3.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & procurement path — hosted vs dedicated vs private

Marissa / Lena —

I'll prepare a one-page commercial summary and an initial 12-month quote for Dedicated (monthly invoice terms). Marissa — can you share the estimated committed QPS / tokens per month so I can pick the right commit band?

Dev — please stand by to take the vendor security questionnaire once Lena's team uploads it.

Thanks,
Aditya
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finservco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@finservco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finservco.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & procurement path — hosted vs dedicated vs private

Marissa / Aditya —

Thursday 10/4 didn't work for our legal; can we do Monday 10/7 11:00 AM PT? Otherwise Tuesday 10/8 afternoon PT would work.

We are ready to proceed with a 12-month Dedicated commit pending:
- Final commercial summary and quote for PO issuance (monthly invoiced).
- Completed vendor questionnaire (security review).
- Confirmation whether you can support an AWS Marketplace private offer for consolidated billing (if feasible, that will be preferred).

I'll have Miguel (legal) on the call to confirm redlines for MSA if needed.

Thanks —
Lena
Senior Procurement Manager, FinServCo
thread_summary: Sales follow-up post-demo to qualify procurement path: customer prefers PO for 12-month Dedicated commit but will pilot Hosted. Procurement requires vendor form + SOC2 + W9. Sales to produce one-page commercial summary, 12-month quote, and coordinate security questionnaire; marketplace private offer is a preference to explore.
